purpose: User-authorized direct post-training video experiment. Previous length threshold preserved but not treated as a ban on diagnostic inference.
model_path: public pretrained frozen MusicFM -> entire trained raw H sequence adapter and predicted-length head -> image structural prefix plus raw action tail -> original DiT text condition projection/token refiner

visual_review.method: Actual reference-plus-six-time-frame mosaics for original music, swapped music and zero music, compared with the previously generated raw H MSE baseline. Not continuous audio listening or a calibrated music/adherence evaluation.
visual_review.staircase: Original and swapped music retain hand gestures and backward leg lifts, differing in some late facing/gesture frames. Zero music still produces similar steps and leg lifts. White/navy sportswear and a small bag replace the reference pale yellow top/grey trousers in all variants; reference outfit fidelity remains incorrect.
visual_review.red_shirt: Original and swapped music both use hand-near-mouth and head-side raised-arm motifs with late gesture differences. Zero music has visibly larger late two-arm raising/spreading, so conditioning changes the output, but this does not establish which music yields correct choreography. The frame crops prevent a reliable footwork claim.
visual_review.store: Original and swapped music remain low-amplitude single-arm, torso and weight movement with closely related sequence. Zero music still generates arm/weight changes. No complete MotionScript sequence or useful musical increment established.

length_layout_confound: Changing music also changes predicted tail length and DiT packed layout. These inference outputs are unmodified deployed behavior; differences alone do not isolate musical token-content causality.
audio_scope: The selected audio stream was fully decoded and sampler traces real input music to mux; no independent decoded-audio equality test was performed.
conclusion: Direct inference of the previous raw-H CLIP model is feasible without retraining or length calibration. Music/zero interventions do alter some generated gestures, but original/swapped outputs retain strong shared motifs and outfit drift persists. The current three-case evidence has not established music replacing action text with comparable usable control. The prior62% representation test is not a video score; do not use it or the failed length gate as a substitute for actual video observation.
not_claimed: all direct native H or CLIP schemes impossible
publication_scope: Code, commands, complete integrity/evidence JSON and qualified analysis only; no checkpoint weights, feature tensors, images or videos uploaded

subsequent_user_review.verbatim: 还是完全不像跳舞,动作和之前差不多,而且更换歌曲的差别也不大.
subsequent_user_review.kind: User qualitative video feedback, not inferred from automated metrics or task notifications
subsequent_user_review.verdict: Current candidate fails the requested usable music-to-dance/text-replacement objective
subsequent_user_review.scope: Overall reported impression; no invented per-video numerical ratings or exhaustive case scoring

training_deployment_length_difference: Training raw-H loss uses ground-truth caption token lengths to mask and bound supervised queries; deployment computes qmax outputs and truncates using the learned predicted length. Same parameterized condition mapping, not identical effective lengths/masks, and no ground-truth length at inference.
